#include "shift_rows.h"

void ShiftRows(state_t *state) {
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=state
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=return bundle=CTRL_BUS

    uint8_t temp;

    // Row 1: Rotate left by 1
    temp = (*state)[1][0];
    (*state)[1][0] = (*state)[1][1];
    (*state)[1][1] = (*state)[1][2];
    (*state)[1][2] = (*state)[1][3];
    (*state)[1][3] = temp;

    // Row 2: Rotate left by 2 (equivalent to swapping 0<->2 and 1<->3)
    temp = (*state)[2][0];
    (*state)[2][0] = (*state)[2][2];
    (*state)[2][2] = temp;
    temp = (*state)[2][1];
    (*state)[2][1] = (*state)[2][3];
    (*state)[2][3] = temp;

    // Row 3: Rotate left by 3 (equivalent to rotating right by 1)
    temp = (*state)[3][3];
    (*state)[3][3] = (*state)[3][2];
    (*state)[3][2] = (*state)[3][1];
    (*state)[3][1] = (*state)[3][0];
    (*state)[3][0] = temp;
}

void ShiftRows(state_t *state) {
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=state depth=16
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=return

    state_t temp_state;
    
    // Copy the original state to temporary state
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            temp_state[i][j] = (*state)[i][j];
        }
    }

    // Perform ShiftRows operation
    for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            (*state)[i][j] = temp_state[i][(j + i) % 4];
        }
    }
}
